text:
mira: dropping a short review of the Prompt Sets / Evals scorecard mock. key asks: final placement for the approve CTA on long lists, wording for confirmation modal, and minimal a11y changes. figma: https://redwood.design/s/ps-eval-scorecard (1/3)

ben: For long lists i prefer the CTA in a sticky footer (after DOM content) so keyboard users tab through rows first. visually we can add a subtle shadow so its obvious.

lucy: Agree sticky footer. Copy nit: change modal confirm from "Approve" to "Confirm approvals" and make the toast message "Approved X tests (undo)". avoids implying config changes.

sam: a11y: when approvals complete, announce via role=status: "Approvals completed: 5 tests approved." Also add aria-describedby on rows that have failing details.

mira: good. also propose a compact keyboard cheat-sheet: 'j'/'k' navigate rows, 'space' toggle select, 'shift+a' approve selected. show it in header under help.

a11y-bot: Check: color of failing pill needs 4.5:1 contrast as sole cue. consider icon + color and visible focus outline. Missing aria-label on the floating undo button.

ben: visual test: please include snapshot for 360px width with sticky footer visible to catch overlaps.

lucy: filter UX: add a persistent "New failures" chip and ensure mobile shows top-3 chips inline, rest under More.

mira: i'll update figs and push copy changes. will add the small a11y checklist to PR. thanks! :thumbsup:
